cases.detail: Icarus rejects the partial-range sensitivity source with constant selects in always_* processes are not fully supported and always_latch process has no event control. It rejects the function-write source with functions cannot have non blocking assignment statements. Both diagnostics reproduce without the suite adapters. IEEE 1800-2023 9.2.2.2.1 defines sensitivity at the longest static prefix, 9.2.2.3 permits the nonblocking latch form, and 13.4 does not forbid scheduling NBA updates of module variables.
